LESSON: READING 3.2.2 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Reading 3.2.2 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 3.2.2 Comprehension, part of Strand 3 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to understand what we read?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. to read the title and look at the pictures to make predictions about the story. Learners with blindness are guided to read the picture description to make predictions about the story.

2. discuss the possible outcome of the story with peers.

3. read a text and locate phrases and sentences to get the meaning of new words.

4. locate sentences containing answers to direct questions and use them to answer questions.

5. respond to indirect questions using contextual clues.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. to read the title and look at the pictures to make predictions about the story. Learners with blindness are guided to read the picture description to make predictions about the story.
2. discuss the possible outcome of the story with peers.
3. read a text and locate phrases and sentences to get the meaning of new words.
4. locate sentences containing answers to direct questions and use them to answer questions.
5. respond to indirect questions using contextual clues.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 3.2.2 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital literacy; interaction with digital devices with assistive technology is enhanced as the learner reads digital texts to pick out words with the

target letter- sound combinations,

● Creativity and imagination as the learner makes predictions about a story.

● Communication; the learner’s ability to speak clearly and effectively is enhanced as they discuss with peers the possible outcomes of the story

Values:
● Unity; cooperation is enhanced as the learner collaborates with others in group activities during role play.

● Respect; acceptance as the learner appreciates diverse opinions of others during group activities.

Pertinent Contemporary Issues:

● Education for Sustainable Development; Disaster Risk Reduction is enhanced as the learner becomes aware of safety at home,

● Life skills; self-esteem – the learner’s self-esteem is improved as they respond to direct and indirect comprehension questions.

Link to other Learning areas:

The learner links the vocabulary in the comprehension text to learning concepts of transport in social studies.
